description: Traits are your character’s inherent talents, either natural abilities that come to you effortlessly or physical features such as a tail, a pair of wings, or horns. Regardless of the form they take, traits serve as a means for you to express your character’s appearance. Think of them as the equivalent of 'race' or ‘ancestry’ in classic RPG terms, but instead of a pre-bundled collection, Sellswords offers a myriad of individual selections for you to mix and match.
acquisition: Your character can acquire up to a maximum of five (5) Traits at any time. You can purchase Traits during character creation only.
pro_tip: Some of the Traits' effects only apply in combat. However, during roleplaying, feel free to go beyond the limitations of your Traits' effects as long as it makes sense. For instance, if you have the trait 'Small,' you can use it to roleplay entering tight spaces, such as a vent.
